info.description: Approve before activating server calendar acceptance. Uses existing closure and route records. Empty or expired policy cannot book dates.

Revision.description: Operator revision; changing any consumed schedule or closure also changes its server hash.

ApprovalReference.description: Link/reference to Peter or the operating owner approval covering this complete calendar.

OriginPostalCode.description: Five-digit carrier origin ZIP; must match the configured carrier account origin.

QuoteTtlSeconds.description: Time before customer selection must be refreshed. Also capped by its ordering cutoff.

OperationsWeekdays.description: Recurring plant preparation weekdays; array of full weekday names.

UPSDispatchWeekdays.description: UPS handoff weekdays; array of full weekday names.

UPSArrivalWeekdays.description: Allowed customer arrival weekdays; array of full weekday names.

UPSCarrierWeekdays.description: Days counted toward carrier business transit; array of full weekday names.

UPSPreparationDays.description: Plant preparation days before carrier handoff.

UPSOrderCutoffTime.description: Eastern HH:mm on the planned preparation date.

UPSPackTime.description: Eastern HH:mm at which cold-chain exposure begins on the preparation date.

UPSArrivalByTime.description: Conservative Eastern HH:mm for the end of the arrival-date estimate; not a carrier guarantee.

UPSMaxElapsedHours.description: Maximum approved packed-to-arrival exposure, including weekends and holidays.

UPSAllowNonDeliveryDayHold.description: Explicit operating approval to allow time spanning non-delivery days. False retains the no-hold rule.

CalendarPreparationDays.description: Plant pickup preparation operating days before pickup.

CalendarCutoffDays.description: Plant pickup order cutoff, calendar days before pickup.

CalendarCutoffTime.description: Plant pickup Eastern order cutoff HH:mm.

CalendarPackTime.description: Plant pickup Eastern pack-ready time HH:mm.
